newFindings.title: Unicode whitespace after sentence terminator does not split as specified
newFindings.comparison: ASCII space and tab split into two sentences.
newFindings.impact: Sentence count, sentence selection and highlight granularity differ. Text is retained; no claim of speech content loss.
newFindings.cause: segmentText scans only ASCII space and tab after .!?; the supplied SPEC says whitespace without that restriction.
newFindings.recommendedFix: Define one sentence-separator whitespace predicate consistent with the contract; handle CR/LF as existing explicit separators and support Unicode whitespace such as U+3000 and U+00A0. Preserve text order and the documented normalization at joins.
recommendedTests: U+3000 and U+00A0 before uppercase/digit/opening quote
CRLF, decimal, abbreviation and length regressions
newFindings.environmentAssessment: Deterministic pure-core logic, not Linux voice availability.

newFindings.title: Inspection banner adds a second language link that reloads and clears input
newFindings.sourceEvidence: Deployed HTML line 13 includes ordinary language anchors. App binds state-preserving click only to #language; pagehide/pageshow/new document init clear state.
newFindings.observedByParent: Generate with fmax=3 and custom sample; #language to English preserves input/CSS. Banner Traditional Chinese link navigates a fresh page, resets fmax to2/sample/default and clears result.
newFindings.scope: Public-inspection overlay integration; original #language remains working.
newFindings.contractInterpretation: SPEC section2.5 language changes retain sample validity state, section2.6 and A14 preserve numeric/CSS state on language toggle. It also explicitly says ordinary navigation/reload has no persistent input. Therefore this is inconsistent duplicated language-control behavior, not a requirement to preserve all navigation/reloads.
newFindings.recommendedFix: Share same-document language switching across explicitly identified same-tool language anchors, including overlay, based on target language/URL. Preserve modifier/middle-click and cross-origin native navigation. Do not add storage or URL query state. Alternatively remove the duplicate overlay language control where the integrated tool already has it.
recommendedTests: Both language controls in both directions after generation
Both controls with numeric error and 241-code-point sample
Ordinary reload and pagehide remain reset/no-persistence
newFindings.environmentAssessment: DOM wiring and lifecycle; not a Linux arithmetic/build issue.
